tech_debt.description: Migration 0002_master_tables.py was hand-authored from ORM (not `alembic --autogenerate`) because no PG instance was provisioned during dev. DDL exactly mirrors Base.metadata; constraint names align with TC-018 / TC-026. Verification deferred: PO must run `cd backend && docker-compose up -d db && alembic upgrade head`; optionally `alembic check` to confirm no spurious diff vs ORM.

T-025 seed_master_data.py runtime verification (33 inserts on first run / 0 on re-run, exact PRD rows per TC-007/011/015/016/022/030) deferred until W5 closes (same PO action chain as TD-005). Static cross-check against TC expected_output is CLEAN.

ORM TimestampMixin uses `Mapped[datetime]` → SQLAlchemy emits plain TIMESTAMP (without timezone), not TIMESTAMPTZ as the LLD prose suggests. Migration 0002 mirrors the ORM (DS-009). If TIMESTAMPTZ semantics are wanted, edit base.py (`mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), ...)`) and ship a follow-up migration in S2 or earlier. Not blocking V1 since all writes go through SQLAlchemy and reads round-trip via the same column type.

carry_forward_tasks: PO action W5: bring up PG and apply migrations + seed. Steps: (1) write backend/.env with DATABASE_URL=postgresql+psycopg://trading_app:<pwd>@localhost:5432/jayanth_trading; (2) docker-compose up -d db; (3) cd backend && alembic upgrade head; (4) python -m scripts.seed_master_data; (5) re-run step 4 to confirm 0-insert idempotency. Closes TD-005, TD-006, opens TC verification gate for Phase 3.
known_constraints: DS-005 V1 no-auth — must remain explicit; any S2 endpoint that introduces user-state requires the Auth module slot from HLD.
DS-008 soft-delete only — repository BaseRepository exposes soft_delete(); no delete(). S2 transaction modules MUST honor this; FKs in 0002_master_tables use ON DELETE RESTRICT to enforce at the DB.

DS-009 Alembic source-of-truth — ORM (Base.metadata) is canonical; any S2 schema change must be ORM-first then `alembic --autogenerate` (or hand-authored ORM-mirror with `alembic check` verification per TD-005 pattern).
DS-010 /api/v1 versioning — S2 routers must mount under this prefix; breaking changes spawn /api/v2 in parallel.
suggested_prd_updates: No PRD changes required from S1 learnings. All 25 backend tasks and 15 UI tasks delivered per spec; no acceptance-criteria slippage observed.
new_risks: R-S1-01 (low): TIMESTAMP vs TIMESTAMPTZ drift (TD-007). Materializes only if backend is deployed in a timezone different from PG container's. Mitigation: TIMESTAMPTZ migration in S2.
R-S1-02 (low): PG container not yet brought up in dev environment (W5). Mitigation: PO action chain is documented and self-contained; nothing in S1 is undeliverable, only un-verified at runtime.
